chapter.verse: Thu palsatna in migilopa’ lungsim tawngah thu gen a, ama mai-ah Pasian zahtakna om lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ama mawhna kidawk khia lo, muhdahna thuak lo ahih manin amah kimawk phat tawm hi.
Ama kammalte in siatna leh khemna vive hi a, pil gamtatna leh hoih gamtatna bei khin ta hi.
A lupna tungah siat gamtat ding sawm a, hoih lohna-ah amah kibulhtawm hi; amah in siatna nolh lo hi.
Topa aw, na itna kip in van ban a, na cihtakna in meii ban hi.
Na thumanna in Pasian’ mualte tawh kibang a, na thukhennate in tuipi thuk tawh kibang hi; mihing leh ganhing na hon hi, Topa aw.
Pasian aw, na itna kip bangzahta in manpha! Mihing tate na kha lim-ah bu uh hi.
Na inn sunga na tampite tawh amaute nuamsa uh a, na lungkimna gun panin amaute dawn ding na pia hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nuntakna tuinak nang tawh om a, na khuavak sungah kote in khuavak ka mu uh hi.
Nang hong theite tungah na itna kip hong zom in la, lungsim thutangte tungah na hotkhiatna hong zom in!
Kihihsakna khe kei hong sik khasak kei in la, kei pen migilote, hong hawlkhiasak kei in.
Hia lai-ah siatna bawlte cimawh-in kun uh a, amaute kisuncip sukin, tho zo lo uh hi.
